verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's own docs call it 'the open-source platform for feature flags and A/B testing', its public GitHub repo describes it as 'Open Source', and an independent commenter confirms it is open source with an optional cloud SaaS, so the source is readable. The evidence never names the license, so the 'open license' part is asserted rather than documented, and paid tiers leave it unclear whether all features are covered. Missing for 10: the specific license named (e.g. MIT), clarity on which code or features fall under it versus commercial tiers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
